_note: Additional situations with roles that are not in the five official cases. No expected answers are stored here: the eval's judge decides from the source documents whether the screen answers each question.

situations.title: Medication reconciliation before surgery
situations.description: You are the clinical pharmacist. Reconcile her medication before the breast surgery in May 2016.
questions: Which drugs are on her latest medication list, with doses?
Which dose changed between the 2015 and 2016 lists?

situations.title: Planning adjuvant endocrine therapy
situations.description: You are the medical oncologist planning adjuvant therapy after surgery.
questions: Is osteoporosis or bone treatment documented?
What was the last documented ejection fraction?

situations.title: Admission to the surgical ward
situations.description: You are the ward nurse admitting her for the operation on 16 May 2016.
questions: Does she inject any medication, and how often?
What is her latest documented weight?

situations.title: Request for CT angiography with contrast
situations.description: You are the radiologist asked to perform a CT angiography with iodinated contrast.
questions: Is a contrast reaction documented, and what happened?
What did earlier imaging of the neck arteries show?

situations.title: Eye check-up follow-up
situations.description: You are her GP. An ophthalmologist asks what was found in 2015 and whether the recommended eye check-ups happened.
questions: What did the 2015 eye examination find?
Is a later eye check-up documented?
